title: Bryan Johnson: The man who spent $10m to cheat death and age in reverse | Prof. Tim Spector
description:
🥑 Make smarter food choices. Become a member at http://zoe.com 

What if optimizing your sleep could significantly extend your lifespan?

In this episode, we dive into the science of longevity with Bryan Johnson, the entrepreneur spending millions to reverse aging, and Professor Tim Spector, one of the world’s top 100 most-cited scientists and an expert in nutrition and the gut microbiome.

Bryan has dedicated his life - and his body - to testing cutting-edge health interventions to slow down aging. His meticulous approach to sleep, diet, and exercise has sparked global debate. But how much of it is backed by science? Tim Spector joins the conversation to separate fact from fiction, revealing what actually works when it comes to sleep, longevity, and optimizing health.
